query: Mon Paris & Beyond Cafe, Brandon, FL
name: Mon Paris & Beyond Cafe

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sunny SouthLove
reviewSamples.text: First time going here and it was lovely. Being a new place, we had to sample all the things of course, so we got 3 different lunch meals, hot and cold drinks, and dessert/ pastries to go! Everything we had was delicious and the owners are super friendly and sweet.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of NKY Blitz
reviewSamples.text: A hidden French gem in Valrico! Amazing desserts and an extremely welcoming atmosphere. The owners are wonderful — you can really feel the authentic French touch. Definitely recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ahmad Abu shalfah
reviewSamples.text: I highly recommend this place! True to their name, this owner and cafe go above and beyond… serving the most delicious coffees, drinks, imported French/European pastries, sandwiches made to order, and beyond! Wow! Great service and a wonderful experience! ☕️⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ⭐
